```{r}
library(car)
library(dplyr)

library(corrplot)
```
#load datasets

```{r}
fabae<-read.csv("../../../../../Documents/metabolomic_too_heavy_for_git/phytohormons/Phytohormones_Batch-1.csv")
fabae <- fabae  %>%
  filter(!is.na(weight))

fabae_without_3 <- fabae %>%
  filter(hpi != 3)

pisum<-read.csv("../../../../../Documents/metabolomic_too_heavy_for_git/phytohormons/Phytohormones_Batch-2.csv")
pisum <- pisum  %>%
  filter(!is.na(weight))

pisum_without_3 <- pisum %>%
  filter(hpi != 3)


three_biotypes<-read.csv("../../../../../Documents/metabolomic_too_heavy_for_git/phytohormons/Phytohormones_Batch-3.csv")
three_biotypes <- three_biotypes %>%
  filter(!is.na(SA))
three_biotypes_without_3 <- three_biotypes %>%
  filter(hpi != 3)





```

# pisum
##PCA
```{r}
df<-pisum


# ================================
# PCA with explanatory factors
# ================================

# ---- Ensure factors ----
df[,1:3] <- lapply(df[,1:3], as.factor)

# ---- Remove rows with NA in numeric data ----
df <- df[complete.cases(df[,7:ncol(df)]), ]

# ---- Select numeric data for PCA (columns 6 to end) ----
pca_data <- df[,7:ncol(df)]

# ---- Run PCA ----
pca <- prcomp(pca_data,
              center = TRUE,
              scale. = TRUE)

# ---- Explained variance ----
explained_var <- (pca$sdev^2) / sum(pca$sdev^2)

# ---- Create PCA dataframe ----
pca_df <- as.data.frame(pca$x)

# ---- Add explanatory factors ----
pca_df$Factor1 <- df[[1]]
pca_df$Factor2 <- df[[2]]
pca_df$Factor3 <- df[[3]]


# ---- Create combination of all three factors ----
pca_df$Combo <- interaction(pca_df$Factor1, pca_df$Factor2, pca_df$Factor3, sep = "_")

# ---- Plot PCA ----
pisum_PCA<-ggplot(pca_df, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = Combo)) +
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.8) +
  stat_ellipse(aes(group = Combo), linewidth = 0.8) +
  labs(
    x = paste0("PC1 (", round(explained_var[1]*100,1), "%)"),
    y = paste0("PC2 (", round(explained_var[2]*100,1), "%)"),
    color = "Factor1 + Factor2 + Factor3"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "right"
  )

```
##correlation
```{r}

df<-pisum[,-c(1:7) ]

# Compute correlation matrix
cor_mat <- cor(df, use = "complete.obs")

# Plot
correlation_pisum<-corrplot(
  cor_mat,
  method = "square",      # filled squares
  type = "lower",         # lower triangle only
  col = colorRampPalette(c("red", "white", "blue"))(200),
  tl.col = "black",       # text label color
  tl.cex = 0.8,           # label size
  addCoef.col = "black",  # show correlation numbers
  number.cex = 0.6
)

```
## SA
```{r}
# -----------------------------
# 1. Control treatment order
# -----------------------------
pisum$treatment <- factor(
  pisum$treatment,
  levels = c("control", "P123")
)

# -----------------------------
# 2. Keep only original data
# -----------------------------
plot_df <- pisum

# -----------------------------
# 3. Plot
# -----------------------------
SA_pisum<-ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = hpi, y = SA, color = treatment)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.4) +
  stat_summary(
    fun = median,
    geom = "line",
    aes(group = treatment),
    linewidth = 1.5
  ) +
  facet_grid(genotype ~ treatment) +
  theme_bw()
```

# fabae
##PCA
```{r}
df<-fabae


# ================================
# PCA with explanatory factors
# ================================

# ---- Remove rows with NA in numeric data ----
```

#three biotype
##PCA
```{r}
df<-three_biotypes


# ================================
# PCA with explanatory factors
# ================================

# ---- Ensure factors ----
df[,1:2] <- lapply(df[,1:2], as.factor)

# ---- Remove rows with NA in numeric data ----
df <- df[complete.cases(df[,5:ncol(df)]), ]

# ---- Select numeric data for PCA (columns 6 to end) ----
pca_data <- df[,6:ncol(df)]

# ---- Run PCA ----
pca <- prcomp(pca_data,
              center = TRUE,
              scale. = TRUE)

# ---- Explained variance ----
explained_var <- (pca$sdev^2) / sum(pca$sdev^2)

# ---- Create PCA dataframe ----
pca_df <- as.data.frame(pca$x)

# ---- Add explanatory factors ----
pca_df$Factor1 <- df[[1]]
pca_df$Factor2 <- df[[2]]


# ---- Create combination of all three factors ----
pca_df$Combo <- interaction(pca_df$Factor1, pca_df$Factor2, sep = "_")

# ---- Plot PCA ----
PCA_three<-ggplot(pca_df, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = Combo)) +
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.8) +
  stat_ellipse(aes(group = Combo), linewidth = 0.8) +
  labs(
    x = paste0("PC1 (", round(explained_var[1]*100,1), "%)"),
    y = paste0("PC2 (", round(explained_var[2]*100,1), "%)"),
    color = "Factor1 + Factor2 + Factor3"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "right"
  )

```
